workarounds.symptom: Windows: signal.SIGBUS AttributeError makes every CLI/MCP entrypoint unusable (1.4.1.1)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Windows: build the crash-signal sets from what the platform defines. Target files: kiln/src/kiln/openscad_runner.py, kiln/src/kiln/slicer.py, kiln/tests/test_openscad_runner.py. CPython's `signal` module on Windows has no `SIGBUS` and no `SIGTRAP`. `openscad_runner` read `SIGBUS` at import time, and `kiln.cli.main` reaches it through `kiln.generation`, so every entrypoint (`serve`, `doctor`, `--help`) died with `AttributeError` on 1.4.1.1. `kiln.slicer` carried the same fault twice over, one lazy import further down: the firs... (Ref: https://github.com/codeofaxel/Kiln/pull/147)
